chapters.title: Organ Emergence from Measured Gamma
chapters.h1: Organ Emergence from Measured Master-Gene Gamma
chapters.one_liner: Four organs emerge from measured master-gene γ (RUNX2 1.2414 < TBX5 1.4392 < SOX9 1.4598 < MYOD1 1.4933); γ is read-only, never fitted.

chapters.title: Force-Frequency: Twitch Summation to Fused Tetanus
chapters.h1: Force-Frequency: Twitch Summation to Fused Tetanus
chapters.one_liner: Twitches superpose into fused tetanus at 25 Hz (band 20–100) and fusion tracks 1/τ [V]; amplitude ratio uncalibrated [O].

chapters.title: Length-Tension from Filament Overlap
chapters.h1: Length-Tension as a Filament-Overlap Contact Number
chapters.one_liner: Active force = filament overlap (contact number); plateau 2.05–2.25 µm, zero near 3.625 µm, matching the cited length-tension curve [V].

chapters.title: Wolff Remodelling as a Yield Threshold
chapters.h1: Wolff Remodelling as a Jamming Yield Threshold
chapters.one_liner: Bone density = R19 state, load = drive, spinodal 0.5324 = yield threshold; supra-threshold load flips density with hysteresis (memory) [F].

chapters.title: Growth-Plate Ordering by Gamma Rank
chapters.h1: Growth-Plate Developmental Order from Gamma Rank
chapters.one_liner: γ-rank reproduces limb→cartilage→muscle (TBX5→SOX9→MYOD1) [V]; bone ossification timing is drive-gated [O].

chapters.title: Muscle Fatigue as Reversible Decline
chapters.h1: Muscle Fatigue as a Reversible Exponential Decline
chapters.one_liner: Sustained drive → reversible exponential force decline, τ≈59.75 s (band 20–120), recovery to 97% [V]; magnitude [O].

chapters.title: Carcinogen Dose-Response in Bone and Soft Tissue
chapters.h1: Carcinogen Dose-Response: a Barrier-Lowering Kernel
chapters.one_liner: Carcinogen = barrier-lowering drive → Kramers RR(dose) collapses to universal convex RR=edose/dose* [V] across four sites; radiation anchor [L]; incidence + fusion/metabolic aetiology [O].

chapters.title: Master-Gene Dosage Dysplasias (CCD, Campomelic, Holt-Oram)
chapters.h1: Master-Gene Dosage Dysplasias as a Forced Crossing Cliff
chapters.one_liner: Haploinsufficiency (dosage 0.5) drops the master switch below a γ-independent crossing cliff at ⅔ WT drive: CCD/RUNX2, campomelic/SOX9, Holt-Oram/TBX5 fail to cross [F]; timing [O].

chapters.title: Mechanostat Disease: Osteoporosis and Osteopetrosis
chapters.h1: Mechanostat Disease: Osteoporosis and Osteopetrosis as the Mirror of Wolff's Law
chapters.one_liner: Disuse osteoporosis = sub-threshold load lowering the dense-basin barrier; loss rate rises 1.00→2.59× with unloading [F]; osteopetrosis removes the loop's down-branch [V]; BMD [O].

chapters.title: Neuromuscular Transmission: Myasthenia and Lambert-Eaton
chapters.h1: Neuromuscular Transmission Failure: Myasthenia Gravis and Lambert-Eaton
chapters.one_liner: MG raises the NMJ threshold → 18.4% low-frequency force decrement (>10% clinical) [V]; LEMS gives the opposite high-frequency increment (+46.7%) [V]; synaptic cause cited [L].

chapters.title: Metabolic and Mitochondrial Myopathy
chapters.h1: Metabolic and Mitochondrial Myopathy as a Fatigue Perturbation
chapters.one_liner: Metabolic myopathy shortens the T5 fatigue τ (60→25 s) and leaves recovery incomplete (0.835<0.95) [V]; magnitude [O].

chapters.title: Osteoarthritis as Cartilage Unjamming
chapters.h1: Osteoarthritis as Cyclic-Fatigue Unjamming of the Cartilage Contact Network
chapters.one_liner: OA = cyclic-fatigue unjamming of the cartilage contact number (cited Paris/Basquin m=2): sub-threshold protected, loss convex in load+BMI [V]; absolute rate [O].

chapters.title: Achondroplasia as Growth-Plate Suppression
chapters.h1: Achondroplasia and Chondrodysplasias as Growth-Plate Switch Suppression
chapters.one_liner: Achondroplasia = FGFR3-GOF suppressive drive on the SOX9 growth-plate switch; graded shortening WT 1.00→0.09 with a cliff [V]; absolute length [O].

chapters.title: Muscular Dystrophy and Sarcopenia
chapters.h1: Progressive Muscle Loss: Dystrophy (Contractile-Contact Fatigue) and Sarcopenia
chapters.one_liner: Dystrophy = contractile-contact fatigue with reading-frame severity (DMD 0.46 < BMD 0.85 < normal 1.00) [V]; sarcopenia = gradual multi-axis ageing decline [V]; absolute timeline/force [O].

chapters.title: Muscle Channelopathies: Myotonia and Periodic Paralysis
chapters.h1: Muscle Channelopathies as Depolarization-Block-Threshold Shifts
chapters.one_liner: Myotonia raises the depolarization-block threshold (1.30), periodic paralysis lowers it (0.10) vs normal (0.80) — opposite excitability signs from one FHN membrane [V]; absolute [O].

chapters.title: Stress Fracture and Fracture Healing
chapters.h1: Stress Fracture as Sub-Yield Bone Fatigue, and Fracture Healing as Remodeling Re-Cross
chapters.one_liner: Stress fracture = sub-yield cyclic bone fatigue above an endurance limit (S-N), sub-endurance protected [V]; and the fracture HEALS via T3 re-cross (0.00→1.00) unlike OA; absolute cycles [O].

chapters.title: Tendinopathy as Collagen-Network Unjamming
chapters.h1: Tendinopathy as Cyclic-Fatigue Unjamming of the Tendon Collagen Network
chapters.one_liner: Tendinopathy = cyclic-fatigue unjamming of the tendon collagen contact number (OA kernel): sub-threshold protected, loss convex in overuse [V]; absolute rate [O].

chapters.title: Osteomalacia and Rickets as a Mineralization Ceiling
chapters.h1: Osteomalacia and Rickets as a Mineralization Ceiling (Load Cannot Rescue)
chapters.one_liner: Osteomalacia/rickets = mineralization ceiling (density = matrix × mineral supply); load rescues osteoporosis but NOT osteomalacia [V]; absolute mineral density [O].

chapters.title: Osteolytic Bone Disease as Osteoclast/Osteoblast Uncoupling
chapters.h1: Osteolytic Bone Disease (Myeloma, Giant-Cell Tumour) as Osteoclast/Osteoblast Uncoupling
chapters.one_liner: Osteolytic bone disease = osteoclast/osteoblast uncoupling: myeloma disables formation (locked lytic 0.15), the mirror of osteopetrosis; GCT's RANKL drive resorbs dense bone (→0.00) [V]; absolute lesion [O].

chapters.title: Out-of-Class and Material Disease Register
chapters.h1: Out-of-Class and Material Diseases: Honest Open Grades and Seam Routing
chapters.one_liner: Material diseases (OI, EDS/Marfan) and signatureless ones (Paget, scoliosis) carried as honest [O] (tendinopathy now §17); degenerative disc disease deferred to the existing OA/tendinopathy kernel to avoid duplication; autoimmune, crystal, pain, infection and distant-primary tumours routed to siblings via named seams (SSOT).

chapters.title: Treatment Axis: Barrier Restoration
chapters.h1: The Treatment Axis: Disease Run in Reverse on a DNA-Grounded Switch (Barrier Restoration)
chapters.one_liner: Treatment = disease run in reverse on a DNA-grounded switch (each organ emerged from a measured gene parameter gamma read from the human genome): restore the barrier / drive / branch / supply. 13 reversible mirror treatments restore the healthy attractor by direction (No-Tuning), each citing the real drug or load; developmental cliffs, cartilage regeneration and established-tumour chemotherapy are honest [O]. Engine hash unchanged.

chapters.title: Bone and Cartilage Treatments
chapters.h1: Bone and Cartilage Treatments as Mirror Operations on the RUNX2/SOX9 Switch
chapters.one_liner: Bone / cartilage mirror treatments on the RUNX2 / SOX9 switch: loading + antiresorptive reverse osteoporosis, vitamin D refills osteomalacia, HSCT re-enables resorption (osteopetrosis), denosumab removes the osteolytic / giant-cell-tumour RANKL drive, rest + load heals stress fracture, vosoritide partially relieves achondroplasia, unloading arrests osteoarthritis (no cartilage regen [O]).

chapters.title: Muscle and Neuromuscular Treatments
chapters.h1: Muscle and Neuromuscular Treatments: Restoring Excitability and Contractile Knobs
chapters.one_liner: Muscle / neuromuscular mirror treatments: pyridostigmine restores the myasthenic safety factor (decrement below 10%), amifampridine raises Lambert-Eaton quantal content, mexiletine normalises channelopathy excitability, steroids + gene therapy modify muscular dystrophy (Duchenne toward Becker), resistance training partially reverses sarcopenia (ageing floor [O]), eccentric loading rebuilds tendinopathy.

chapters.title: Honest Treatment Limits and Scope
chapters.h1: Honest Treatment Limits: Where the Kernel Has No Restoration Knob (Results, Not Failures)
chapters.one_liner: Honest treatment limits (results, not failures): developmental dosage cliffs are not postnatally reversible (closed window), osteoarthritis cartilage does not regenerate (arrest-only), established-tumour chemotherapy is out of the initiation kernel’s scope while primary prevention is verified [V], and only a cofactor-responsive subset of metabolic myopathy reverses; every open item names its obstacle.

chapters.title: Analgesic Axis: Three-Lever Threshold Logic
chapters.h1: Non-Opioid Analgesia as a Threshold-Crossing Rate: The Inherited Three-Lever Technique
chapters.one_liner: Non-opioid analgesia = pull one of three levers on the nociceptive THRESHOLD-CROSSING rate on the same DNA-grounded R19 barrier (L1 raise the peripheral barrier / L2 lower the noxious drive / L3 cut the central gain). Technique inherited from the VP non-opioid analgesic volume (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20733420); the noxious drive is read from each disease kernel (single source). PASS = crossing rate falls monotonically (DIRECTION, No-Tuning). L3 central gain is a neuro/mind seam; opioid lever out of scope. Engine hash unchanged.

chapters.title: L2 on Load-Bearing Disease: Analgesia-Disease Convergence
chapters.h1: Lever L2 on the Load-Bearing Diseases: Where Analgesia and Disease-Modification Converge
chapters.one_liner: L2 (lower the noxious drive) on osteoarthritis, tendinopathy and stress fracture: the noxious drive is the mechanical load the disease kernel perturbs, so unloading lowers BOTH the nociceptive crossing rate AND the structural contact loss (verified by DIRECTION). Analgesia and disease-modification converge on one knob; the mirror treatment (offload) is the dominant analgesic. No-Tuning.

chapters.title: L1 and the Coupled/Decoupled Discriminant
chapters.h1: Lever L1 and the Falsifiable Coupled/Decoupled Discriminant (with Osteolytic Bone Pain)
chapters.one_liner: L1 (raise the peripheral barrier) lowers the crossing rate but leaves the lesion FLAT (structure-decoupled), while L2 lowers both (structure-coupled) -- that contrast is the decisive falsifiable discriminant. Osteolytic/myeloma bone pain is the clean L2 case where the antiresorptive that relieves the RANKL drive is both the mirror treatment and the analgesic; cancer bone pain is opioid-first-line and the opioid lever is honestly out of the non-opioid scope.

chapters.title: Analgesic Limits and the Central-Gain Seam
chapters.h1: Analgesic Limits and the Central-Gain Seam: What Is Routed Out and Why (Results, Not Failures)
chapters.one_liner: Honest limits: L3 central gain is owned by neuro/mind and cited as a seam (not re-emerged); the opioid descending/mu lever is outside the non-opioid logic; exertional muscle pain is DIRECTION-only with no structural cross-check; neuropathic pain and fibromyalgia are routed to sibling volumes (SSOT). The axis stays strictly inside the load-bearing class -- results stated as scope, not failures.
